5. I will scan the trial transcripts for any read of the reference fields or the grader files. I will void any trial that peeked.

Then I will propose harder tasks or stricter graders for round 6. Examples are poor-quality scans, multi-page invoices, credit notes, and planted PO mismatches. I will write the spe/predictions/r05-draft.yaml draft and update spe/README.md. Then I will commit `SPE r05 learn: ...` and tag `spe-r05`.

I will report back after step 6, before I start the learn step.
